description: Monitor and Phones volume knob (Simple view, Output view, iOS app). Knob position 0..1 along the 270 degree arc <-> level in dB. The trim taper of the sliders (frontend/src/lib/fader.ts trimDbToPos), stretched so the floor sits at position 0. Values are whole dB; one key press, wheel notch or VoiceOver swipe is 1 dB; there is no double-tap reset.
